title: Two roads for resize
music: playful curious explainer music, light pizzicato strings, soft marimba and warm synth pad, gentle groove, 100 bpm

lines.say: The old road: resize is a BFF save.
The new road goes straight to rust-resizer. The resize flag picks the road.
Both roads end at the Media store.
Flag off, and resize takes the old road. Crop never left it.
lines.moral: Check: flag off, crop on the BFF, error toasts.
